root_cause: The offcanvas component always enforces focus trapping and sets aria-modal=true regardless of the backdrop setting, preventing keyboard navigation to elements outside the panel when backdrop=false.
repair_strategy: Make the offcanvas non‑modal when backdrop is false: conditionally apply aria-modal/role attributes and the focus‑enforcement listener only when this._config.backdrop is true, preserving the existing modal behavior when backdrop=true.
expected_accessibility_effect: Users can tab from the help panel into the amount field and other form controls while the panel is open, meeting WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard and 2.4.3 focus order requirements.
functional_risks: Removing modal attributes may change how assistive technologies announce the panel, but the panel is intended to be non‑modal when backdrop=false.
Ensure that the default backdrop=true case continues to trap focus and behave as a modal dialog.
verification_requirements: With data-bs-backdrop="false" (as in the test), tabbing from the panel should reach #amount within ≤6 tabs.
With data-bs-backdrop="true" or default, focus should remain trapped inside the panel when tabbing.
Opening and closing the panel via the button and ESC key should work correctly in both configurations.
ARIA attributes (aria-modal, role) should be present only when backdrop=true.
